decisive_items: Irregular mass in pelvic area with multiple nodules
blurred margin with adjacent rectum and sigmoid colon
response.rationale: Smooth muscle tumor with irregular, nodular, margin-blurring pelvic mass fixed to adjacent bowel favors leiomyosarcoma; prior hysterectomy makes uterine leiomyoma implausible, and IHC excludes GIST/SFT.

rejected.why: Uterine leiomyoma is implausible after total hysterectomy and does not explain an extrauterine fixed, margin-blurring invasive mass; low Ki-67 is the only benign feature.
CD34 positivity is nonspecific; SMA/desmin positivity and smooth muscle tumor favor leiomyosarcoma, and SFT lacks these smooth muscle markers.
Endometriosis is not supported by biopsy showing smooth muscle tumor; history of endometrioma is incidental.
